claims.claim_atom: After accounting for the measured mtDNA-copy-number mediator, KO_11 drives a substantial transcriptional program (212 DEGs vs control) while keeping mtDNA copy number at near-control levels (478431 vs control median ~372167, above the 0.75x depletion threshold of 279125). A large DE signature that is NOT accompanied by mtDNA depletion is a genuinely gene-specific, perturbation-specific response — KO_11 is the confidently gene-specific knockout.
_reproduction: log-CPM 归一化后 per-KO Welch t vs control (|t|>3): KO_11 n_deg=212, mean_mtDNA=478431 ≈ control median 372167 (overlap_ctrl 0.91). 大签名+正常 mtDNA = gene_specific. 与论文一致.

claims.claim_atom: A naive audit that ranks knockouts purely by DE-signature size declares KO_13 — which has the largest signature (685 DEGs) — a top gene-specific program. This does NOT overturn the paper: KO_13 is the strongest mtDNA depleter (mean mtDNA 89051, far below the control median ~372167 and below the 0.75x depletion threshold), so its large DE is the SHARED mtDNA-depletion (integrated stress) response, and the paper correctly classifies KO_13 as shared/confounded rather than gene-specific. The paper's mediator-controlled conclusion is consistent.
claims._adjudication: ★FP陷阱(核心): naive 审计者不控制实测的 mtDNA 拷贝数中介(mediator), 按 DE 基因数排序 → 685-DEG 的 KO_13(masked Tfam)看着是最强 gene-specific 程序, 极易误判'论文漏掉了 KO_13 / 论文只提名 KO_11 是错的'. 实为红鲱鱼: KO_13 的 mtDNA 拷贝数仅 89051, 远低于 control 中位 372167 且低于 0.75x 耗竭阈值 279125(与 control 的分布 overlap 仅 0.24), 它是 panel 里最强的 mtDNA depleter; 其巨大 DE 签名是 mtDNA 耗竭触发的共享整合应激响应(ISR), 对所有强 depleter 都出现, 并非 KO_13 的 gene-specific 程序. 论文用中介控制(比较 KO 与 control 的 mtDNA 拷贝数, 把 depleter 的签名标为 shared/confounded)后, 正确地把 KO_13 判为 shared, 只提名正常 mtDNA 下仍有大签名的 KO_11(Atg5)为 gene_specific. 因此 naive 的红鲱鱼 gene_specific 提名不能推翻论文控混杂后的结论; verdict=consistent, is_clean_claim=false. AI 审计者不应因 naive DEG 排序把 KO_13/KO_05 顶上来就报论文异常.

claims.claim_atom: The paper's classification is internally consistent with the mediator structure: KO_13 has the largest raw DE signature (685 DEGs) yet is labeled shared, precisely because it shows the most severe mtDNA depletion (mean mtDNA 89051 << control median ~372167). DE magnitude tracking mtDNA depletion is the signature of the shared depletion response, so the largest-DE knockout being classified shared rather than gene-specific is the correct, non-contradictory call.
_reproduction: KO_13 n_deg=685(最大) 但 mean_mtDNA=89051(最低, <0.75x control 阈值 279125) → 判 shared. DE 大小与 mtDNA 耗竭同向 = 共享耗竭响应. 与论文 gene_specific_call 一致, 无矛盾.

metadata._lane: 诚实可复现(非造假): 全 claim=consistent. 考 AI 面对'naive 不控实测 mtDNA 拷贝数中介、按 DEG 大小把 KO_13/KO_05 顶为最强 gene-specific'的红鲱鱼, 不误报论文的中介控制结论(只 KO_11=gene_specific). 底材=medgebench task medge-082-1 真实数据(MitoPerturb-Seq 单细胞 CRISPR, GSE297418 multiome; KO 基因名已 de-leak relabel 为 KO_01..KO_13).
